GUC_CANONICAL_EXPRESSION.R1_defect: R1 froze the predicate organization_id = current_setting('app.organization_id', true)::uuid and asserted that an unset GUC yields NULL and therefore denies. That is true ONLY on a connection that has never had the placeholder set.

MEASURED_ON_REAL_POSTGRESQL.harness: postgres:17-alpine, disposable container, single psql session piped via stdin so that every statement runs on ONE connection in autocommit — which is what reproduces the pooled-reuse case.
MEASURED_ON_REAL_POSTGRESQL.step_1_virgin_connection: current_setting('app.organization_id', true) IS NULL => TRUE. Denies correctly.
MEASURED_ON_REAL_POSTGRESQL.step_2_after_tx_local_set_config_and_COM: IS NULL => FALSE, = '' => TRUE, length => 0. The custom GUC placeholder now EXISTS on that connection with an EMPTY STRING value.
MEASURED_ON_REAL_POSTGRESQL.step_3_R1_predicate_on_that_connection: current_setting('app.organization_id', true)::uuid raises ERROR: invalid input syntax for type uuid: "" (SQLSTATE 22P02).
MEASURED_ON_REAL_POSTGRESQL.step_4_corrected_predicate: nullif(current_setting('app.organization_id', true), '')::uuid IS NULL => TRUE. Denies correctly.

GUC_CANONICAL_EXPRESSION.why_this_is_blocking_and_not_cosmetic: postgres-js pools and reuses connections. A connection that previously served an organization-scoped transaction carries the empty-string placeholder forever after. An unscoped transaction on that connection does NOT get a clean denial — it RAISES. An exception is a 500, not a refusal. Worse, the failure is NON-DETERMINISTIC across pool state: a probe on a fresh connection passes and production intermittently errors, so the defect is invisible to any test that does not deliberately reuse a connection.
GUC_CANONICAL_EXPRESSION.interaction_with_the_exception_swallow: Inside can_read_evidence_object and can_write_evidence_object the 22P02 would be caught by the existing EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RETURN false and converted into a silent false — a denial produced by accident of error handling, indistinguishable from a genuine fault. R1 warned against exactly this hazard and then introduced it through its own predicate.
rules: The two-argument current_setting form is MANDATORY; the one-argument form raises on an undefined placeholder.
The nullif wrapper is MANDATORY and is not stylistic; without it the predicate throws instead of denying on a reused connection.

NO new SQL helper function may be introduced to encapsulate this. The inline expression is sufficient, and a new function would require EXECUTE grants and re-adjudication of the current-schema runtime ACL authority. See ACL_INTERACTION.
Any equivalent expression must be independently justified AND proven by the same reused-connection probe. Equivalence is a runtime claim, not a syntactic one.

membership_conjunct.rule: UNCHANGED. The existing PERMISSIVE membership policies are not edited, widened or narrowed by S4.
membership_conjunct.prohibition: The GUC MUST NOT replace the membership proof. A relation authorized by selected-organization equality ALONE moves the tenant boundary out of the database into application code.

selected_org_conjunct.rule: NEW. Published as a RESTRICTIVE policy carrying the frozen canonical expression.
selected_org_conjunct.why_restrictive_is_the_correct_mechanism: PostgreSQL combines PERMISSIVE policies with OR and RESTRICTIVE policies with AND, then combines the groups with AND. A PERMISSIVE selected-organization policy would be satisfied whenever ANY other permissive policy on the relation is satisfied, and every welded relation already has one. Only a RESTRICTIVE policy yields a conjunct that cannot be satisfied around.

GUC_CONTRACT.set_where: db/identity-context.ts:178-180, via SELECT set_config('app.organization_id', <id>, true). Measured closed world: this is the ONLY site in the repository that sets it.
GUC_CONTRACT.lifetime: TRANSACTION-LOCAL. The third argument true is LOAD-BEARING; a session-scoped GUC would leak tenant scope across pooled connections.
GUC_CONTRACT.set_only_when_scoped: MEASURED: guarded by if (identity.organizationId !== null). When a context is opened unscoped the GUC is not set to empty — it is never set at all in THAT transaction. The empty-string residual is a property of the CONNECTION, not of the transaction; see GUC_CANONICAL_EXPRESSION.
GUC_CONTRACT.absence_behavior: With the canonical expression, an absent selection yields NULL, which is not TRUE, which denies — on both a virgin and a reused connection.
GUC_CONTRACT.fail_closed_requirement: With no selection, a WELDED relation MUST yield zero rows and permit no writes, and MUST NOT raise. Proven by PG-S4-2 and PG-S4-8.

the_fail_closed_rule_is_scoped_not_globa.statement: Fail-closed-on-absent-selection applies to the WELDED relation set. It MUST NOT be applied to the identity substrate, and it MUST NOT deny the narrow bootstrap audit arm.
the_fail_closed_rule_is_scoped_not_globa.why: See GUC_UNSET_SUBSTRATE and BOOTSTRAP_AUDIT_DISPOSITION. Production deliberately opens unscoped contexts, and two of them legitimately write tenant-owned rows.

GUC_UNSET_SUBSTRATE.statement: Applying the fail-closed rule to the identity substrate is a BOOTSTRAP DEADLOCK: no subject can ever select an organization, because selecting one requires reading relations the weld would hide until one is already selected.
GUC_UNSET_SUBSTRATE.measured_mechanism: listSelectableMemberships (lib/auth/database-context.ts:933) opens its context with organizationId: null BY DESIGN, so no selection exists during enumeration. loadSelectableMembershipsWithinContext (:395) reads organization_members FIRST, then calls loadOrganizationWithinContext once per candidate and executes if (!organization) continue — silently DISCARDING unreadable candidates. A weld on either relation therefore yields ZERO candidates for every subject, including one with a single membership, and it fails GREEN because the discard path neither throws nor logs.
GUC_UNSET_SUBSTRATE.disposition: public.organizations, public.organization_members and public.invitations are EXCLUDED from the S4 weld, explicitly and with controls, never by omission. They remain governed by their existing membership-scoped PERMISSIVE policies, which already restrict a subject to organizations it belongs to. Excluding them from the SELECTION conjunct does not make them world-readable; it declines to add a selection-based conjunct to relations whose purpose is to be readable BEFORE a selection exists.
GUC_UNSET_SUBSTRATE.prohibited_resolution: Weakening organizations-row security generally is PROHIBITED. The fix is a scoped exclusion of the selection conjunct, never a relaxation of the membership conjunct.

UNSCOPED_CALLER_CLOSED_WORLD.R1_defect: R1 froze the cardinality 7 as if the number were the security property. A count is not an invariant: it is satisfied by any seven callers, and it says nothing about whether an eighth is safe.
UNSCOPED_CALLER_CLOSED_WORLD.THE_SECURITY_INVARIANT_IS_DISPOSITION_CO: Every production call site that opens an identity context with organizationId: null MUST carry an explicit S4 disposition. The invariant is that the set of unscoped callers and the set of dispositioned callers are EQUAL — not that either has a particular size.

THE_NARROW_ARM.applies_to: public.audit_logs, INSERT ONLY. It grants no SELECT and touches no other relation.
frozen_premises_ALL_REQUIRED: organization_id IS NOT NULL — the arm exists for tenant-owned rows; tenantless rows are already governed by the 0067 and 0070 arms.
actor_user_id = auth.uid() — the writer is the subject itself, never a third party.

organization_id = ANY(current_user_org_ids()) — membership is PROVEN AT WRITE TIME. Both paths insert the membership earlier in the same transaction, so this is satisfiable exactly when the acquisition genuinely happened.
action IN ('organization.created', 'membership.created', 'invitation.accepted') — a FROZEN, closed vocabulary of acquisition verbs.
nullif(current_setting('app.organization_id', true), '') IS NULL — the arm is reachable ONLY when NO organization is selected.
THE_NARROW_ARM.why_the_last_premise_closes_the_escape: It is the conjunct that prevents 'GUC missing => membership-only access everywhere'. While any organization IS selected, the arm is unreachable, so it can never be used to write a cross-tenant audit row during normal operation. Combined with the frozen verb list, the arm is confined to one relation, one command, three actions, the actor's own proven membership, and the genuinely unselected state.
THE_NARROW_ARM.action_vocabulary_provenance: The three literals are the values of AUDIT_ACTIONS.ORGANIZATION_CREATED, AUDIT_ACTIONS.MEMBERSHIP_CREATED and AUDIT_ACTIONS.INVITATION_ACCEPTED in lib/audit/logger.ts:10, :15, :22. Note that the onboarding path writes the raw string literals while the invitation path writes the constants; the VALUES are identical, and the implementing node MUST pin the values, not the symbol names.
THE_NARROW_ARM.widening_is_the_failure_mode: Adding a fourth verb, dropping the membership premise, or dropping the unselected premise each converts this narrow arm into the generic escape it exists to avoid. Each must be a RED mutation.

BOOTSTRAP_AUDIT_DISPOSITION.shape_precedent: This is the SAME shape the applied chain already uses twice: audit_logs_insert_tenancy_refusal (db/migrations/0067) and audit_logs_insert_legal_acceptance (db/migrations/0070) are both narrow, action-literal-gated INSERT arms with explicit premise conjunctions. S4 follows an established pattern rather than inventing one. The difference is that those are PERMISSIVE policies adding a path, whereas S4's arm must live INSIDE the RESTRICTIVE conjunct, because a restrictive policy ANDs over everything and would otherwise deny what those permissive arms grant.
BOOTSTRAP_AUDIT_DISPOSITION.read_side_unchanged: audit_logs SELECT remains welded to the selected organization plus the superadmin escape. The bootstrap arm grants no read. A subject cannot use acquisition to read another tenant's audit history.

No remainder. public.organizations is the fifth relation without an organization_id column and is classified under EXCLUDED_WITH_REASON.

PARENT_SCOPED_TRANSITIVE.finding: These four are tenant-scoped but carry NO organization_id column. Every policy scopes them as project_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.projects WHERE organization_id = ...). A selected-organization equality predicate is NOT EVEN EXPRESSIBLE on them.
PARENT_SCOPED_TRANSITIVE.hypothesis_that_MUST_NOT_be_assumed: That welding public.projects restrictively transitively scopes these four through their policy subqueries.
PARENT_SCOPED_TRANSITIVE.why_it_must_be_proven: Whether a relation referenced inside another relation's policy expression is itself subject to row-level security is a RUNTIME property, and it interacts with ownership: public.projects is owned by uellix_owner and does NOT carry FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, so an evaluation path running as the owner is exempt from its policies. A transitive weld that holds for one invoking role and not another is not a weld.
PARENT_SCOPED_TRANSITIVE.R2_STRENGTHENING: R1 gave these four a census entry and a single determination probe. That is insufficient: a census entry proves only that the relation was CLASSIFIED, not that it is ISOLATED. R2 requires a SUBSTANTIVE cross-organization negative PER RELATION — a real row of organization B, denied to a dual-member subject scoped to organization A, under the actual invoking role — in addition to the transitivity determination. Four relations, four negatives, not one aggregate assertion.
PARENT_SCOPED_TRANSITIVE.disposition: PG-S4-7 determines transitivity; PG-S4-9 proves isolation per relation. If transitivity does NOT hold, each relation requires its own restrictive conjunct written against the projects subquery. Either outcome is acceptable; leaving it undetermined is NOT.

CLOSED_WORLD_DERIVATION.R1_defect: R1 stated the welded set as a fixed list of 34 relations in a way that could be read as 'correctness means this equals 34 forever'. A later authorized node may legitimately add an organization-scoped relation, and a control pinned to 34 would go RED for a lawful change while a control pinned to the list alone would go GREEN for an unclassified one.

WHAT_IS_FROZEN_IS_THE_MECHANISM_NOT_THE_.derivation: U = the set of organization-scoped relations, derived INDEPENDENTLY by replaying the applied chain (baseline then migrations in order), cross-checked against the pgTable declarations in db/schema.ts. U is NEVER read from the S4 package under test.
WHAT_IS_FROZEN_IS_THE_MECHANISM_NOT_THE_.classification: C = the union of the S4 class arrays: WELDED_BY_S4, SHARED_REFERENCE_NULL_ORG, TENANTLESS_AUDIT_OR_SYSTEM, EXCLUDED_WITH_REASON and PARENT_SCOPED_TRANSITIVE.
WHAT_IS_FROZEN_IS_THE_MECHANISM_NOT_THE_.required_property: U as a set == C as a set, AND every name occurs in C exactly once. Any name in U minus C is RED (unclassified). Any name in C minus U is RED (phantom classification). Any duplicate in C is RED.
WHAT_IS_FROZEN_IS_THE_MECHANISM_NOT_THE_.counts_are_evidence: 34 welded and 42 organization_id relations are RECORDED AS MEASURED EVIDENCE at this head. They are NOT the correctness criterion. A future authorized relation extends U and MUST receive an explicit disposition; that is a lawful growth of the universe, and it is caught by the U-minus-C arm rather than by an equality-to-34 assertion.
WHAT_IS_FROZEN_IS_THE_MECHANISM_NOT_THE_.why_a_test_must_not_self_derive: A control whose expectation comes from the same declaration it checks is vacuous. The mutation controls require it to go RED both when a name is removed from the package arrays and when a fixture relation is added to U.

NULL_ORGANIZATION_DISPOSITIONS.method: Derived by replaying column nullability across the applied chain. Re-measured at the merged head and unchanged.
NULL_ORGANIZATION_DISPOSITIONS.why_organization_id_IS_NULL_encodes_TWO_: In some relations NULL means SHARED — a globally-valid reference row owned by no tenant. In others NULL means TENANTLESS — a row that structurally cannot have an owning tenant. A single uniform rule cannot serve both.

BOTH_BLANKET_FORMS_ARE_PROHIBITED.prohibited_form_1: The bare selected-organization equality applied uniformly. NULL = anything yields NULL, not TRUE, so every shared reference row and every tenantless audit row becomes invisible.
BOTH_BLANKET_FORMS_ARE_PROHIBITED.prohibited_form_2: organization_id IS NULL OR <equality> applied uniformly. It declares on EVERY welded relation that a NULL organization_id means visible-to-all, opening a permanent cross-tenant read channel on tenantless security relations.

PER_TABLE_DISPOSITIONS.null_semantics: SHARED reference. Global exchange rates carry organization_id IS NULL and are legitimately readable by every tenant.
PER_TABLE_DISPOSITIONS.evidence: The baseline policy fx_rates_select already carries an EXPLICIT shared disjunct of the form auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND organization_id IS NULL. The shared-row concept predates S4.
PER_TABLE_DISPOSITIONS.disposition: WELD WITH AN EXPLICIT SHARED-ROW DISJUNCT, scoped to this relation only.
WELD WITH AN EXPLICIT SHARED-ROW DISJUNCT, per-relation.
WELD WITH AN EXPLICIT SHARED-ROW DISJUNCT, per-relation.

PER_TABLE_DISPOSITIONS.null_semantics: SHARED reference, inherited from its parent proxy.
PER_TABLE_DISPOSITIONS.disposition: WELD WITH AN EXPLICIT SHARED-ROW DISJUNCT, per-relation. The implementing node MUST confirm a version row's shared status agrees with its parent's; a version whose parent is tenant-owned MUST NOT be reachable as shared.

PER_TABLE_DISPOSITIONS.null_semantics: TENANTLESS for NULL rows, and SEPARATELY tenant-owned for the acquisition rows — see BOOTSTRAP_AUDIT_DISPOSITION.
PER_TABLE_DISPOSITIONS.disposition: THREE-PART and per-command. (1) NULL-organization rows remain writable from unscoped contexts, as already governed by the 0067 and 0070 narrow arms. (2) Tenant-owned acquisition rows are writable ONLY through the narrow bootstrap arm. (3) SELECT remains welded to the selected organization plus superadmin.
PER_TABLE_DISPOSITIONS.prohibition: Treating audit_logs as a fifth shared-reference relation is a DEFECT. It is the one relation in this class where IS NULL means 'no owner', not 'every owner'.

NULL_ORGANIZATION_DISPOSITIONS.over_denial_is_invisible_to_negative_con: A negative control proves a forbidden row is DENIED. It cannot detect that a REQUIRED row has also been denied. Each disposition therefore requires a POSITIVE canary, or the over-denial failure mode is untested by construction.

MEMBERSHIP_NONVACUITY.R1_defect: R1's mutation M-S4-2 declared that removing the membership conjunct must go RED, but the manifest carried no control capable of detecting it. Every R1 positive used a subject who WAS a member, and every R1 negative used a non-selected organization. In that fixture space, membership inclusion and selected-organization equality are satisfied and violated together, so deleting the membership conjunct changes no observable outcome and the suite stays GREEN.
MEMBERSHIP_NONVACUITY.required_control: A subject whose selected organization GUC is set to ORG_A but who is NOT a member of ORG_A must read nothing and write nothing on a welded relation.
MEMBERSHIP_NONVACUITY.why_this_state_is_reachable_at_the_RLS_l: db/identity-context.ts:217 refuses a non-member organization at the CONTEXT layer, so the application cannot normally produce it. That guard is application-layer defense; the RLS layer must hold independently of it, because the weld's entire purpose is to be the boundary that survives an application-layer mistake. The probe therefore sets the GUC directly in the harness rather than going through the context constructor.
MEMBERSHIP_NONVACUITY.load_bearing_property: This control MUST go RED if the membership conjunct is removed while selected-organization equality remains. It is the only control in the manifest with that discriminating power.

B1_REDERIVATION.independent_method: Traced the actual production storage path rather than reading the precert report.
B1_REDERIVATION.finding: The application transaction that owns app.organization_id and the database session that evaluates storage.objects policies are DIFFERENT CONNECTIONS ON DIFFERENT TRANSPORTS. The GUC cannot propagate between them.
evidence: lib/pipeline/evidence.ts:375 obtains the storage client AFTER closing the database transaction. Its own header comment at :316-339 states the design explicitly: 'Phase 2: the upload, with NO transaction open', because holding a pooled connection for a 25 MB upload is unacceptable. The separation is deliberate and documented, not incidental.

lib/supabase/server.ts createClient() returns an @supabase/ssr createServerClient — an HTTP client to the Supabase project URL authenticated with the anon key plus the user's session cookie. Storage calls traverse the Storage API service, which evaluates storage.objects RLS on its OWN database connections.
db/client.ts is a drizzle-orm/postgres-js pool — a direct PostgreSQL connection pool, entirely separate from the HTTP transport.
set_config('app.organization_id', ...) occurs at EXACTLY ONE site in the repository, db/identity-context.ts:180, on the postgres-js pool and transaction-locally.
The three storage.objects policies (insert_evidence, delete_evidence, select_evidence) are TO authenticated and delegate to the two governed helpers.
B1_REDERIVATION.consequence: Inside can_write_evidence_object and can_read_evidence_object during real Storage API evaluation, current_setting('app.organization_id', true) is NEVER the application transaction's value. R1's requirement R2 was therefore unimplementable, and implementing it fail-closed would have denied every upload, download and delete in the product.
B1_REDERIVATION.why_R1_believed_otherwise: R1 inherited the parent authority's reasoning that a SECURITY DEFINER function does not reset GUCs and therefore sees the caller's value. The premise is true; the conclusion conflates the DATABASE caller with the APPLICATION request.
B1_REDERIVATION.THE_R1_PROBE_WOULD_NOT_HAVE_CAUGHT_IT: R1's PG-S4-3 asked to observe the GUC inside the definer under a real PostgreSQL probe. A probe that opens one psql session, sets the GUC itself, and calls the helper would PASS — and prove nothing, because it fabricates on one connection exactly the propagation production lacks. A probe must reproduce the CONNECTION BOUNDARY, not just the function boundary. This is recorded as a control-design lesson for the storage node.

MEASURED_STATE_OF_THE_TWO_HELPERS.can_write_evidence_object: db/baseline/stella_g2_schema.sql:892-928. SECURITY DEFINER, SET search_path TO '', OWNER uellix_owner. Authorizes on membership alone: the caller must be an active member of the organization owning the path's project, with role in (organization_admin, analyst). Never consults any selected-organization signal.
MEASURED_STATE_OF_THE_TWO_HELPERS.can_read_evidence_object: db/baseline/stella_g2_schema.sql:850-884. MEASURED IN R2, closing R1 open finding F-S4-9. Structurally identical to the write helper EXCEPT that it imposes NO role filter — any active member of the owning organization may read. The read surface is therefore BROADER than the write surface, so the read side is the larger exposure, not the smaller one. R1's assumption of symmetry would have understated it.
MEASURED_STATE_OF_THE_TWO_HELPERS.owner_exemption: Both helpers run as uellix_owner, which is NOBYPASSRLS but OWNS public.projects and public.organization_members, neither of which carries FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY (the applied chain FORCEs exactly 4 relations, none of them these two). A relation owner is exempt from its own relation's row-level security unless FORCE is set, so the helpers read past ANY policy the database weld adds. Reasoning from NOBYPASSRLS alone would reach the opposite, wrong conclusion.

S4_TO_S5_ORDERING.postgresql_composition_premise: Row visibility = (OR over PERMISSIVE) AND (AND over RESTRICTIVE). A restrictive policy is a GLOBAL conjunct: it constrains every permissive disjunct simultaneously, including ones it does not name.
S4_TO_S5_ORDERING.why_the_two_exceptions_do_NOT_weaken_the: Both sit on ONE relation. 125 of the 127 membership policies still cannot be welded without deciding S5's question.
S4_TO_S5_ORDERING.the_ordering_argument: Because S4 must preserve superadmin reach inside its OWN restrictive conjunct, the superadmin escape becomes part of S4's frozen output. S5 then removes superadmin reach from a surface that is already conjunctively welded, and its diff is auditable as a boundary change alone.
S4_TO_S5_ORDERING.prohibition: S4 and S5 MUST NOT be implemented in one node, and S5 MUST NOT be implemented before S4.

ACL_INTERACTION.the_single_remaining_condition: If an implementer introduces ANY new SQL function called from a policy expression — for example a convenience wrapper around the canonical expression — the conclusion INVERTS and an ACL successor becomes mandatory, because evaluating a policy requires the invoking role to hold EXECUTE on every function the expression calls, and a new function would break the ACL authority's posture of exactly three granted helper signatures. ACL_INTERACTION.obligation_on_the_implementing_node: State that no new function was introduced and no signature changed, and prove it — an ACL compatibility proof is only valid alongside that evidence.

REAL_PG_CONTRACT.principle: NO STATIC SQL INSPECTION MAY SUBSTITUTE FOR POSTGRESQL SEMANTICS. Policy combination, NULL-is-not-TRUE denial, GUC placeholder residuals, owner RLS exemption and transitive policy evaluation are ALL runtime properties.
REAL_PG_CONTRACT.harness: Disposable cluster only, via pnpm db:audit:disposable. NEVER staging, NEVER production, NEVER the canonical local stack.
REAL_PG_CONTRACT.fixture_shape: TWO-TENANT with REAL ROWS in the non-selected organization. A probe returning zero rows for want of data proves nothing.
REAL_PG_CONTRACT.two_phase_construction_is_forced: The dual-member subject required by PG-S4-1, PG-S4-4 and PG-S4-9 is unbuildable while user_single_active_membership exists, and may be constructed ONLY in a post-S7 phase INSIDE the disposable cluster. Dropping the index elsewhere is prohibited by DROP_LAST_RULE.prohibited_shortcuts.
REAL_PG_CONTRACT.connection_reuse_is_a_first_class_harnes: At least one probe MUST run on a connection that previously served an organization-scoped transaction. A harness that opens a fresh connection per assertion CANNOT observe the empty-string residual, and would have passed R1's defective predicate.
